Python stack

Python is the execution layer behind the pages.

The site itself stays simple, while Python handles the real work: services, APIs, automation, and the agent logic that powers the delivery.

Layer 01

FastAPI-style services

A clean API layer for forms, requests, task triggers, and future integrations.

Layer 02

Automation jobs

Scheduled tasks, data cleanup, and lightweight background work that supports the site.

Layer 03

Agent orchestration

A plan-and-verify loop with clear checkpoints, not a black box interface.

Layer 04

Readable handoff

The result is easy for a client or teammate to understand, extend, and run.
